principle: Least privilege equals Stripe visibility: a person sees a report in SaasReport only if their Stripe role already lets them see the data behind it. The default for any role not listed, and for any user whose roles cannot be verified, is no access. An account administrator may grant more inside SaasReport; the grant is recorded and is never the default.
unknowns: How the account owner appears in userContext.roles is not documented; until confirmed in a test-mode install, the owner is treated through the administrator grant path.
userContext.roles can be undefined in some contexts (documented for embedded apps); undefined means no access.

classes.revenue: Subscription and invoice data: recurring revenue, movements, retention.
classes.platform: Platform fees a Connect platform earns on its connected accounts' payments (application fees on the platform's own account).

roles.name: Super Administrator
roles.rationale: Can see and manage almost everything, including financial reports.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.rationale: Similar access to the account owner.

roles.name: Developer
roles.rationale: Can view payments, disputes and customers, and create, view and download financial reports.

roles.name: Analyst
roles.rationale: Can view payments and disputes, and create, view and download financial reports.

roles.name: View Only
roles.rationale: Can view payments, disputes, customers and balance, and download financial reports.

roles.name: Accountant
roles.rationale: Can view payments, disputes, customers and balance, and create, view and download financial reports.

roles.name: Tax Analyst
roles.rationale: Can view payments, disputes and customers, and create, view and download financial reports.

roles.name: Refund Analyst
roles.rationale: Can view and refund payments and view disputes. Cannot download financial reports, so aggregate recurring revenue is not granted by default.

roles.name: Support Associate
roles.rationale: Can view and refund payments and resolve disputes. Cannot download financial reports.

roles.name: Support Specialist
roles.rationale: Can view and refund payments and resolve disputes. Cannot download financial reports.

roles.name: Dispute Analyst
roles.rationale: Can view and resolve disputes and view payments. Cannot refund payments or download financial reports.

roles.name: Transfer Analyst
roles.rationale: Can view balance, payouts, disputes and payments. Cannot download financial reports.

roles.name: IAM Administrator
roles.rationale: Access management only; cannot view payments, balance or financial reports.

roles.name: Support Communications
roles.rationale: Support messages only; cannot access financial information.

roles.name: Terminal Specialist
roles.rationale: Terminal fleet only; cannot view payments.

roles.name: Data Migration Specialist
roles.rationale: Customers and data copies only; cannot view live payments.

roles.name: Connect Onboarding Analyst
roles.rationale: Connected accounts only; cannot view payments or financial reports.

roles.name: Connect Risk Analyst
roles.rationale: Connected-account risk only; cannot create, view or download financial reports. Not granted by default.

roles.name: Sandbox Admin
roles.rationale: Sandboxes only; no access to live data.

roles.name: Sandbox User
roles.rationale: Sandboxes only; no access to live data.

roles.name: Identity Analyst
roles.rationale: Identity verifications only.

roles.name: Identity View Only
roles.rationale: Identity verifications only.

roles.name: Top-up Specialist
roles.rationale: Top-ups, balance and payouts only.

roles.name: Financial Connections Specialist
roles.rationale: Financial Connections only.

roles.name: Data Engineer
roles.rationale: Stripe Data Pipeline only.
